title: Replace js_strict_eq with native serde_json::Value equality at all ~80 call sites; delete all three definitions
action: Locked decision D1 (docs/history/js-parity-cleanup/CONTEXT.md): js_strict_eq dies. Three definitions: canonical verbs/reservations/jsval.rs:77, duplicates hooks/chain_nudge.rs:245 and hooks/state_sync.rs:197. ~80 call sites across ~20 files (hotspots: verbs/state_group/policy.rs 19, verbs/state_group/feature.rs 18, verbs/state_group/workflows.rs ~10, hooks/state_sync.rs 4, verbs/reservations/release.rs 4, verbs/cells/finish_support.rs 4, verbs/workflow_store/projections.rs 4, verbs/decisions/read.rs 3, hooks/chain_nudge.rs 3, plus lease_store.rs, integration_queue.rs, state_group/mod.rs, cells/handlers_select.rs, reviews.rs, tmp_group.rs, workflow_store/record.rs). All observed operands are JSON primitives, where native Value equality is behavior-identical (JSON has no NaN literal). Replace each call with == or != on the compared Values; delete the three definitions and the jsval module if nothing else lives there (check jsval.rs for other exports first — move any live ones). verbs/decisions/read.rs:25 documents a JS-Set/SameValueZero note — rewrite that comment natively. Remove now-unused use imports (28 lines). Do NOT change comparison semantics anywhere else; if a call site provably compares objects/arrays, STOP and log a decision instead of guessing.
